title: Echo Flight incident
place_text: Echo Flight, Malmstrom Air Force Base, Montana

tellings.link_reason: Both are about the 1967 Echo Flight missile shutdown at Malmstrom.

plain: Echo Flight was a group of ten nuclear missiles at Malmstrom, a US Air Force base in Montana. A former Air Force officer named Robert Salas says that around March 16, 1967, the officer in charge there, Walt Feele, was told of something strange, could not believe it at first, and then all ten of his missiles shut down. The podcast host, Jesse Michels, places this eight days before a similar event Salas says he lived through himself, and links it to later cases at the same base. If true, it would mean something unknown could switch off American nuclear weapons.
